fields.description: One way this mission will go about its work, chosen from the society's own VMMS TOR Methodology register. A Link rather than free text so that a society can report across missions on how it works, which a typed-in phrase would never allow.
fields.label: Methodology

fields.description: How this particular mission applies that methodology: who it reaches, how many, over what period. The register says what the method is; this says what it means here. Never read by code.
fields.label: Notes
